rationale: The agent canceled the entire order without explicitly authenticating the user beyond an email lookup, and there was no confirmation with the user before executing the cancellation, which violates the stated policy to confirm every order-changing action prior to writing. The user’s preference was to cancel specific items unless partial cancellation was not possible; the agent did not establish or communicate whether partial cancellation was possible. Additionally, the agent stated that a refund would go to PayPal without tool-supported evidence. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
